questions.question:
18 is related to 90 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 31 is related to 155. To which of the following is 52 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 5) = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 18 : 90

⇒ (18 × 5) = 90.

For, 31 : 155

⇒ (31 × 5) = 155.

Similarly, for 52 ∶ ?

**⇒ (52 × 5) = 260.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

Statements:

All papers are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

All erasers are pens.

Conclusions:

I. All pens are papers.

II. Some papers are erasers.

III. Some pens are pencils.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All papers are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

All erasers are pens.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d723bd2de65026c30cd0ff3f0e63699b1db59c5cb5ffee2aa3c7cc4ea54e9238.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are papers. - **False **(because All papers are pencils, All pencils are erasers and All erasers are pens. So, it can be possible but not definite)

II. Some papers are erasers. - True (because All papers are pencils, and All pencils are erasers. So, Some papers are erasers too)

III. Some pens are pencils. - True (because All papers are pencils, All erasers are pens, and All pencils are erasers. So, Some pens are pencils too)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions II and III follow".**

139 + 40 ÷ 5 − 168 × 3 = 283

In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

Based on the above, how is T related to P if ‘P − M + R ÷ T × S’?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 +
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Son
 Brother
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: P − M + R ÷ T × S

It means: P is the wife of M, M is the son of R, R is the mother of T and T is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22fe0da2f3bfc931538e266cc68c6117cf666b7f64588e932f0eb4eeaf8770b9.png] 

So, T is the '**Husband’s brother**' of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Husband’s brother".

questions.question: All the alphabets in the word 'CARDBOARD' are arranged in the alphabetical order. How many alphabets are there in the English alphabetical series between the alphabet which is fourth from the left end and the one which is second from the right end in the newly formed cluster of nine letters?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

All the alphabets in the word 'CARDBOARD' are arranged in the alphabetical order.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/626d07e0525f711784fd3e4ae32b24a76551e87a9ea4bfa9ea5b855d592bdba9.png] 

The alphabet which is fourth from the left end = **C**

The one which is second from the right end = **R**

Alphabetical series between the alphabet which is fourth from the left end and the one which is second from the right end in the newly formed cluster of nine letters = C, __**D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q**__, R

Thus, **14** alphabets are there in the English alphabetical series between the alphabet which is fourth from the left end and the one which is second from the right end in the newly formed cluster of nine letters.

Hence, the correct answer is** "14".**
